done: The water goes still. The bowl glows clear and steady.
offer: The bowl flickers: three boars, mud in the still water.

steps.journal: The Glasswater bowl showed boars churning the shallows. Drive off three, then come back to the light.

steps.journal: The Pasture Waystone flickered with two bears in the high grass. Drive both off, then return.

steps.journal: Two boars root through the black ash near Ash Mile Waystone. Drive them off and come back to the light.

quests.title: Rooting in the Ash

done: Four short pulses, then one long. The downs are quiet.
offer: Four short pulses. Four dark shapes on the long green.

steps.journal: The Downs Waystone pulsed four times: four boars loose on the green. Drive them off, then return.

done: The pattern runs clean again. The hill answers.
offer: The pattern breaks. Three wolves on the slope below.

quests.returnText: Back to the Signal Hill waystone

steps.journal: Wolves prowl Signal Hill and its waystone stutters. Drive off three of them, then return to it.

quests.title: The Hill Pack

done: The heather springs back. The hum bends with it.
offer: The heather shakes in the bowl. Three boars, rooting.

steps.journal: Three boars are tearing up the heather by Heath Waystone. Drive them off, then come back.

steps.journal: Boars wallow in the black water near Reedmire Waystone. Drive off three of them, then return.

done: Far inland, the Downs light blinks back. The sea hums.
offer: The bowl draws five thin lines, all pointing inland.

steps.journal: The Strand light points inland, where the boars run. Carry five arrows to the Downs Waystone.

offer: Snow light in the bowl. Two bears on the rock below it.

steps.journal: Two bears den on the bare rock below the Whitecombs. Drive them off and return to Combfoot Waystone.
